rules.boundDescription: Non-thinking text, no tools, no vision, no server features. Conservative input ceiling 1048576 tokens times USD 0.30/M plus 8192 output tokens times USD 1.20/M; peak/cache-miss rounded up to micro-USD. Context-limit bound, not local token-count equivalence.

Non-thinking text, no tools, no vision, no server features. Conservative input ceiling 1048576 tokens times USD 1.32/M plus 8192 output tokens times USD 3.96/M; peak/cache-miss rounded up to micro-USD. Native max_tokens support documented in DeepSeek Anthropic guide.

Standard public Search pricing USD5 per 1000 requests. One GET web/search request only; no Answers, AI generation or other endpoints. No free-credit discount assumed; custom enterprise contracts are outside this published-price scope.

Published pay-as-you-go USD0.008 per credit, maximum two credits for advanced search; basic also reserves this conservative ceiling. Explicit depth only, no auto parameters, answer, research, crawl or extract endpoint. No free-credit or volume discount assumed; custom enterprise contracts excluded.

Public Search base USD0.007 up to 10 results plus up to 10 additional results at USD0.001 each, and conservatively up to 10 additional text pages at USD0.001 each: USD0.027 for at most 20 results. Text only, auto company search; no summaries, subpages, deep search, structured synthesis or premium data providers. No free credits assumed.

Global public Text Search Enterprise SKU E967-44BC-B44D: USD35 per 1000 requests at the highest volume-tier price. One POST page up to 20 results. Exact permitted FieldMask subset includes websiteUri; no Atmosphere, generative summaries, reviews, wildcard or pagination. Highest selected SKU only; no free allowance or volume discount assumed.

Public standard and enhanced speed plans: highest published unit rate USD8 per 1000 successful searches (Developer enhanced, USD80 for 10000). One GET Google or Bing search, first page only; no rank tracking, AI engines or other endpoints. Google num fixed10; Bing at most20. No free credits, failed-request refund or lower package rate assumed; custom contracts excluded.
